What does it mean for Fatawin to be a decentralized gaming platform?
The key feature of decentralized gaming platforms like Fatawin is their blockchain-based architecture, which eliminates any central authority or intermediary at all levels and nodes of casino operation (unlike centralized platforms, where gaming and other processes can be influenced in some way).
Decentralized gaming relies on smart contracts — self-executing agreements with transparent rules embedded in system core. These contracts automatically enforce fairness and transparency, ensuring equal winning chances without intermediaries, convenient deposits, and transparent withdrawals without delays. That's why the Fatawin platform is entirely built upon smart contracts.
Additionally, Fatawin's smart contracts have undergone rigorous independent security audits. The entire gaming platform is open-source, allowing thousands of crypto and security experts to thoroughly verify its reliability and security.
